subject.title: [Bug]: mimo-v2.5 / mimo-v2.5-pro thinking content leaked into text reply causing severe repetition

question: Should the MiMo v2.5 hidden-reasoning exposure continue through the public provider bugfix PR path, or should maintainers route it through private security handling before merge?
rationale: The root cause and fix shape are narrow, but the observable impact is hidden reasoning exposed in end-user replies, which is a security-boundary decision automation should not make alone.

options.title: Continue public provider repair
options.body: Treat this as a public P1 provider bug, review the open dedup PR, require targeted regression tests plus redacted live MiMo proof, and close the issue only after merge.

options.title: Route through security first
options.body: Pause the public fix path until a security owner decides whether hidden-reasoning exposure needs private handling or extra disclosure controls.

recommendation.title: Continue public provider repair
recommendation.body: Treat this as a public P1 provider bug, review the open dedup PR, require targeted regression tests plus redacted live MiMo proof, and close the issue only after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties steipete to the current wrapper/helper blame and the prior MiMo replay fix, and this choice needs repository-level provider/security judgment.
